cases.sentence: И ___ похвалил нечестного управляющего за его находчивость.
cases.translation: And the master commended the dishonest manager for his shrewdness.
cases.explain: Хозяин is the subject of похвалил (commended) — subjects take the nominative.

cases.sentence: Управляющий одного богатого ___ был обвинен в растрате имущества своего хозяина.
cases.translation: The manager of a certain rich man was accused of wasting his master's possessions.
cases.explain: Человека shows possession ('a rich man's manager') — the possessive modifier takes the genitive.

cases.sentence: Время ___ и пророков было до Иоанна, сейчас же возвещается радостная весть о Божьем Царстве.
cases.translation: The time of the Law and the prophets was until John; now the good news of God's Kingdom is proclaimed.
cases.explain: Закона shows possession ('the time of the Law') — the possessive modifier takes the genitive.

cases.sentence: Ни один слуга не может служить двум ___.
cases.translation: No servant can serve two masters.
cases.explain: The verb служить (to serve) governs the dative → господам, 'to serve two masters'.

cases.sentence: Затем он спросил второго ___, «А ты сколько должен?»
cases.translation: Then he asked the second debtor, "And how much do you owe?"
cases.explain: Должника is the direct object of спросил (asked) → accusative; for animate masculine nouns the accusative equals the genitive.

cases.sentence: Он одевался в самую дорогую и изысканную ___ и каждый день устраивал великолепные пиры.
cases.translation: He dressed in the most expensive and luxurious clothing and feasted lavishly every day.
cases.explain: В marking what one is dressed into takes the accusative → одежду, 'clothed in fine clothing'.

cases.sentence: Фарисеи, которые любили деньги, слышали все это и посмеивались над ___.
cases.translation: The Pharisees, who loved money, heard all this and sneered at Jesus.
cases.explain: Над (at/over) takes the instrumental → Иисусом, 'sneered at Jesus'.

cases.sentence: В ___, где богач терпел мучения, он как-то поднял глаза и увидел вдали Авраама.
cases.translation: In Hades, where the rich man was in torment, he looked up and saw Abraham far away.
cases.explain: В marking location takes the prepositional; ад is one of the masculine nouns with the special locative ending -у → в аду ('in Hades').

reading.ru: Управляющий одного богатого человека был обвинен в растрате имущества своего хозяина.
reading.question: What is the manager in the parable accused of?
reading.explain: The manager of a rich man was accused of wasting his master's possessions.

reading.ru: Но я знаю, что мне сделать, чтобы, когда меня отсюда уволят, нашлись люди, которые бы приняли меня к себе.
reading.question: What plan does the manager come up with after learning he will be fired?
options: To make friends who will take him in after he loses his job
To beg the master for another chance
To confess everything to the authorities
reading.correct: To make friends who will take him in after he loses his job
reading.explain: The manager decides to secure people who will receive him into their homes once he is removed from his position.

reading.ru: Управляющий сказал ему, «Возьми свою расписку, садись быстро и переделай на пятьдесят».
reading.question: What does the manager tell the first debtor to do with his bill?
options: Rewrite it to owe fifty instead of the original amount
Give it to the master directly
reading.correct: Rewrite it to owe fifty instead of the original amount
reading.explain: The manager tells the debtor who owed a hundred measures of oil to quickly rewrite the bill as fifty.

reading.ru: И хозяин похвалил нечестного управляющего за его находчивость, ведь дети этого мира сообразительнее в делах себе подобными, чем дети света.
reading.question: How does the master react to the manager's shrewd dealings?
options: He commends the manager for his shrewdness
He fires him on the spot
He forgives all the debts himself
reading.correct: He commends the manager for his shrewdness
reading.explain: The master commends the dishonest manager for acting shrewdly, since the people of this world are more shrewd than the people of light.

reading.ru: Вы не можете одновременно служить Богу и богатству.
reading.question: What does Jesus say people cannot do at the same time?
options: Serve two human masters equally well
Love both a father and a mother
Follow both Moses and the prophets
reading.explain: Jesus declares that no one can serve both God and money (mammon) at once.

reading.ru: Фарисеи, которые любили деньги, слышали все это и посмеивались над Иисусом.
reading.question: How do the money-loving Pharisees react to Jesus' teaching?
options: They ask him more questions respectfully
reading.explain: The Pharisees, who loved money, heard all this and sneered at Jesus.

reading.ru: Но скорее небо и земля исчезнут, чем из закона пропадет хотя бы одна черточка.
reading.question: What does Jesus say about the permanence of the Law?
options: Heaven and earth will pass away before the smallest stroke of the Law fails
The Law was only for John's time
The Law applies only to priests
reading.correct: Heaven and earth will pass away before the smallest stroke of the Law fails
reading.explain: Jesus says it is easier for heaven and earth to disappear than for even one small stroke of the Law to fall.

reading.ru: А у его ворот лежал нищий по имени Лазарь.
reading.question: Who lay at the rich man's gate, covered in sores?
options: A servant of the rich man
A relative of the rich man
reading.explain: A beggar named Lazarus, covered in sores, lay at the rich man's gate.

reading.ru: В аду, где богач терпел мучения, он как-то поднял глаза и увидел вдали Авраама, а рядом с ним Лазаря.
reading.question: What does the rich man see while suffering in Hades?
options: Abraham far away, with Lazarus beside him
An empty void with no one else
The gates of his former house
reading.correct: Abraham far away, with Lazarus beside him
reading.explain: In torment in Hades, the rich man looks up and sees Abraham far off, with Lazarus at his side.

reading.ru: И кроме того, между нами и вами огромная пропасть, так что даже если бы кто и захотел отсюда пойти к вам, он не смог бы, и никто оттуда не может перейти к нам.
reading.question: Why can't anyone cross between Abraham's side and the rich man's place of torment?
options: A great chasm separates them that no one can cross
There is a bridge but it is guarded
Only angels are permitted to cross
The rich man refuses to try
reading.correct: A great chasm separates them that no one can cross
reading.explain: Abraham explains that a great chasm is fixed between them so that no one can pass from one side to the other.

reading.ru: Если они Моисея и пророков не слушают, то даже если кто-то воскреснет из мертвых, их и это не убедит.
reading.question: What does Abraham say about convincing the rich man's brothers to repent?
options: If they won't listen to Moses and the prophets, not even someone rising from the dead will convince them
Sending Lazarus back will surely convince them
They will believe if they see a miracle
reading.correct: If they won't listen to Moses and the prophets, not even someone rising from the dead will convince them
reading.explain: Abraham replies that if they do not listen to Moses and the prophets, they will not be persuaded even if someone rises from the dead.
